text: {"rulings": [{"id": "1", "relation": "unrelated", "reason": "A cap of 50 per month on the free tier and an actual platform volume of about 40 per week describe different things; a pricing limit and observed throughput can both hold at once."}, {"id": "2", "relation": "unrelated", "reason": "Marcus's team running numbers with three firms is a past event and says nothing about current weekly shipment volume."}, {"id": "3", "relation": "unrelated", "reason": "Joy building the tracking module and the platform handling forty shipments a week are independent facts that can both be true."}, {"id": "4", "relation": "unrelated", "reason": "What a shipment consists of has no bearing on how many shipments flow through per week."}, {"id": "5", "relation": "unrelated", "reason": "The repo being open source is unaffected by the platform's weekly shipment volume."}]}
